notes.title: Patch 129: PC Non-VR Launch!
notes.content:
[h1]Vegas Infinite is live on PC – No headset required![/h1]
[previewyoutube=inJ80HaJqQw;full][/previewyoutube]
Vegas Infinite has just taken a giant leap. Our game is now available to players on PC through Steam, with [b]no VR headset required[/b]! We’ve completely reimagined the world of Vegas Infinite for PC players, offering fresh perspectives on our breathtaking environments and delivering all the games you know and love. 

Vegas Infinite for PC is free to download and free to play in Early Access on Steam right now.



[h1]VR and PC play together![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/faff01d994dc1d2c765c6b9678b622f0e2e2694f.png[/img]
But that’s not all – this groundbreaking new format enables players on both Meta Quest VR and PC to play together in the same world, at the same time. Your home games just got a lot bigger.




[h1]New Feature: Linked Accounts![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/9bbbb4ad4d4f8d27351685b66186c4c98e034e8f.png[/img]
And for those of you who want to switch seamlessly between VR and PC, you can also take advantage of our new account linking feature. This optional feature means you can use a single email address to link your balance and progress across Meta Quest and Steam. 

You can link your Meta Quest and Steam accounts anytime when you launch the game, or continue on as normal without linking your accounts. 

[b]Remember, if you choose to link your Meta Quest and Steam accounts with your email, the platform you use during set-up will be your primary account. Your linked balance and progress will be based on its balance and progress. For example, if you sign up while using Steam, your balance will be based on your Steam balance.[/b]

And, of course, if you have any problems, our Customer Support team is always here to help. Raise a ticket at https://support.vegasinfinite.com/

There’s a lot more to come, so stay tuned for more updates. And in the meantime, let’s take a look at what’s on the horizon.




[h1]Celebrate the launch with a BANG![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/22ada86a519da70449cc18ca937eee4bf51c8938.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/64742466e8c19bb1dc6de423b046a6e39fb63917.png[/img]

First-time logins will unlock an exclusive [b]PC Backpack[/b], and each daily login earns you [b]100 Creds[/b]! But, we’re not stopping there! To add on this festive day, enjoy a [b]2x Chips & Creds SALE[/b] on us to ensure you have all the essentials you need in Vegas Infinite.



[h1]♾️ 100M Vegas Infinite Freeroll! ♾️[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/5a04410af6be826693b5c1aa74304f1f507c43b2.png[/img]
Join us on [b]Friday, September 29th, at 5 PM ET[/b] for our [b]100M Freeroll Multi-table Tournament[/b], celebrating our rebrand with a massive prize pool. It’s your chance to compete, win big, and be part of Vegas Infinite history.


[h2]Blackjack Standalone tables[/h2]
We’re always looking at where we can improve our game. Analysis of our blackjack standalone tables found that our players prefer to play in more open environments with quick access to other games. So, we’ve decided to remove blackjack standalone tables from Vegas Infinite.

notes.title: PATCH 124: High Stakes Update + MTT Improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Experience the Thrill of High-Stakes Play and Exciting Rewards![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/7f14071ebe20983bc307d880f48c6ce400326240.png[/img]
You asked and we heard you! We’ve made a load of enhancements to our poker games to bring you a better, more strategic, and more thrilling experience.


[h2]Introducing New High Stakes[/h2]
We’re bringing a whole new level of high-stakes play with a new poker stake of 500k/1m and a Spin n' Go Stake of 5m. Keep an eye out for the next level of leaderboard prizes!

[h2]Enhancements to Existing Features[/h2]
We're also capping our 100k/200k Cash tables to 100 big blinds for a deeper and more strategic game.

[h2]Improved Store Creds Packs[/h2]
To show our appreciation to our community, we've increased the number of Store Creds in all packs. Enjoy more customization options and a huge range of props!

[h2]Multi-table tournaments just got better![/h2]
We’ve made a number of changes to improve loading frustrations, including fixing cases of table transfers to ensure uninterrupted gameplay. We've also made improvements to provide a more consistent and high-quality multi-table tournament experience. Get ready to raise the stakes!

[h2]25/50 Cash Game Changes[/h2]
Finally, we want to let you know that as part of these updates, 25/50 Cash game rake has also been increased from 5% to 8%.


[h1]Get in on the action: Weekly Sports Picks Leaderboards![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/1bfb5fdb7b83fec8424043cc4ee3a134f1972ce0.png[/img]
Join our thrilling [b]Weekly Sports Picks Leaderboards[/b]! Compete in 3 different stakes each week based on how many chips you win on individual sports picks. Win big and claim your spot on the leaderboards for a chance to win impressive prizes, including chips and creds. Aim for the top and dominate all 3 leaderboards!


[h1]Level up your sports picks with more options![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635269/1cad5337a7c22a2d63f7cd807f939ab0126af064.png[/img]
We're thrilled to announce the addition of [b]rugby, cricket, and e-sports[/b] to our lineup, offering you even more opportunities to put your knowledge to the test and score big wins. Get in on the action and be part of the winning team!


[h2]New Features:[/h2]
- [b]NEW[/b] Poker Stake: 500k / 1m!
- [b]NEW[/b] Spin n’ Go Stake: 5m!
- [b]NEW[/b] Sports Betting Weekly Leaderboard!
- [b]NEW[/b] Sports Betting Options: E-Sports, Rugby and Cricket!


[h2]Existing Feature Improvements / Modifications:[/h2]
- Optimized Multi-Table Tournaments
- 100k / 200k Cash tables are now capped to 100BB
- 25 / 50 Cash tables rake has been increased from 5% -> 8%
- Credits have received an increased amount in all packs
- Revamped assets: Ruby Heart Necklace, Brown Ale, Lager, Heart Cookie, Bracelet Watch
- Age of Valhalla improvements and polish


[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed muting props in settings causing parts of chip stack to become invisible
- Fixed Spy Glasses laser having no effect on props after first use
- Fixed Runic Torc watch being incorrectly scaled
- Fixed remote players unable to interact with Mustache Stick prop
- Fixed Mustache Stick prop having no thumbnail
- Fixed players being unable to purchase free 0 Star Cred items from the store
- Fixed players getting locked in loading if they spin the spin wheel while quick seating
- Fixed Gingerbread All-in button movement when used
- Fixed Fireplace being invisible to the remote player
- Fixed guests and owners not seeing the same page of leaderboards on smart TV channel
- Various other bug fixes

notes.title: PokerStarsVR_Beta0.9.2.4 Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone Lucky VR dev team here! We'd like to thank you all for such an [b]amazing[/b] launch of PokerStars VR! We've heard your feedback and have made a bunch of quality of life improvements and bug fixes for our first update. 

[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
  [*]Fixed chip clipping on right hand
  [*]Fixed store items freezing when player disconnect while holding them
  [*]Fixed VOIP not fading in/out properly and not working for affected users
  [*]Fixed Quick Seat button make player join old/full room and kick out to lobby
  [*]Fixed Quick Seat button showing up when transitioning to the Quit/Leave panel
  [*]Fixed returning stage chips after crafting too many stacks causing unselectable chips
  [*]Fixed Dash movement not working in SteamVR
  [*]Fixed players spawning into other players in lobby
  [*]Fixed missing card styles in watch menu
  [*]Fixed dealer button freeze when placed on community cards
  [*]Fixed apparel and watches sometimes spawning at world origin
  [*]Fixed wrist UI break if server browser refreshes and active page number is less than the new total pages available
  [*]Fixed max player slider resetting in host table menu when selecting a new environment
  [*]Fixed some players spawning into lobby with a high vertical offset
  [*]Fixed avatar apparel being shared across multiple accounts if accessing from the same machine
  [*]Fingers will no longer make stack grab pose is now disabled while watch menu is open
  [*]Unified grab poses and hold positions on both hands for chip stacks
  [*]Set default texture for deck and burn pile to PokerStarsVR logo
  [*]Various optimizations made in lobby to increase performance
  [*]Taking pictures of other players hole cards when not revealed will yield an obfuscated texture for everyone 
  [*]Twitch chat channel names are no longer case sensitive, just copy the channel name as you see it
[/list]

[h1][b]Features and changes[/b][/h1]
  [*]Turn time decreased by 5 seconds
  [*]Increased Stars Creds payout at the end of each hand
  [*]Twitch camera now has a default smoothing value applied to reduce jittering when moving around
  [*]Twitch camera stream mode now shows monitor overlay card HUD
  [*]Watch handedness swapping has been moved to the gameplay settings menu
  [*]24 hour time format is now available in gameplay settings menu
  [*]Auto rebuy is enabled by default, it can be turned off in gameplay settings in watch menu
  [*]Table listings will now sort by default in order of least populated to most populated
  [*]Various ease of use adjustments made to prize wheel 
  [*]Network optimizations
  [*]Photos are now saved to user/pictures/PokerStarsVR_Photos
  [*]Coin flip sound now only plays locally
  [*]Added Discord link to the social menu
  [*]Lowered volume of bar area in Macau surface 
  [*]Void ambiance volume is now tied to the music slider
  [*]When at a full table UI will show above inactive player’s head indicating how long until they will be kicked
  [*]Throwing fortune cookies hard will now break them open
  [*]Added short buyin indicator for players who’s buyin is less than the table minimum
  [*]If any friends are at a table shown in the browser list, a green dot indicating seat occupancy will show instead of a white dot
[/list]
